_label: Odyssey I DISCOVERY. FIRST audio specimen this session (every prior specimen has been text, DNA, vision, or robot-action) and the FIRST classic encoder-decoder architecture (every LLM specimen surveyed has been decoder-only).

domain.modality: speech-to-text (automatic speech recognition + translation) -- log-mel spectrogram audio in, text tokens out. First audio specimen and first encoder-decoder (seq2seq) architecture this session; every prior specimen has been decoder-only (or, for pi0_base/sam2.1, has no autoregressive text component at all).

architecture_ASYMMETRIC_ENCODER_DECODER_.finding: an 8:1 layer-count asymmetry (32 encoder vs 4 decoder), inherited from the public 'turbo' variant's own design (a known distillation of large-v3's original 32-layer decoder down to 4) -- confirmed here directly from the checkpoint's own tensors, not assumed from the model name. This produces a STRUCTURAL INVERSION of every prior specimen's cost profile this session: the encoder (78.7% of params) runs exactly ONCE per input (non-autoregressive, full audio clip in one pass), while the decoder (only 21.3% of params) is the part that actually runs autoregressively, token-by-token, at inference time -- the SMALL organ dominates inference LATENCY, the LARGE organ dominates one-shot compute and storage. No MoE/sparse specimen this session has raised this particular kind of role asymmetry (all were about which fraction of one pass activates, not about which of two differently-sized passes repeats).
architecture_ASYMMETRIC_ENCODER_DECODER_.conv_frontend: model.encoder.conv1/conv2 -- a small 2-layer conv stack projecting 128 mel-spectrogram channels into the encoder's hidden dimension, confirmed by shape match, not assumed.

byte_accounting_EXACT.tied_embedding_UNVERIFIED: no tensor exists outside the encoder/decoder prefixes, consistent with a tied decoder input/output embedding (Whisper's documented design) -- but UNLIKE iLLaDA-8B earlier this session, this was NOT independently confirmed with a full byte-exact tensor comparison, only inferred from the absence of a separate head tensor. Flagged as an honest gap, not claimed verified.

obvious_representation_opportunities: The encoder/decoder SIZE asymmetry suggests a LATENCY/size asymmetry too: since the decoder runs autoregressively while the encoder runs once, per-token DECODE cost is likely far more sensitive to decoder organ size than encoder organ size -- meaning the encoder (78.7% of params) may tolerate more aggressive compression for inference-latency purposes than the decoder (21.3%) would, the OPPOSITE prioritization from a pure byte-count view. Untested this pass -- a genuinely new lever, distinct from every MoE-organ or tied-embedding finding so far.
failure_modes_not_yet_tested: No capability battery (would need a WER/transcription-accuracy benchmark, entirely outside Hawking's existing text-generation Doctor batteries).
Tied-embedding claim is inferred, not byte-verified (see byte_accounting_EXACT above).
No verification of the actual cross-attention mechanism connecting decoder to encoder output.
preliminary_disposition: RESEARCH SPECIMEN, OUT-OF-DOMAIN FOR HCLI. First audio + first encoder-decoder specimen this session -- genuinely completes a fifth distinct modality class (text-generation, diffusion, robot-action, vision-segmentation, now audio) and raises a new latency-vs-size prioritization question no other specimen surfaced.
